title: Constitutional Morality & Social Democracy
description: Primary source excerpts from BAWS Vol. 13 and speeches on November 25, 1949.

items.archivalQuote: Democracy in India is only a top-dressing on an Indian soil which is essentially undemocratic.
items.citation: Ambedkar, B. R. (1949). CAD Vol. 11, p. 972.
